title: SaaS LMS
summary: A learning platform for one teacher or a whole organisation. The architecture is written down; the build has just begun.
role: Architecture, the decision records and the foundation of the application.
description: A multi-tenant learning management system meant to work equally well for a single teacher and for a large educational organisation. So far it is a design and a foundation: the specification, the architecture and eighteen recorded decisions, on top of a Next.js and Supabase scaffold.
I list it here for the thinking, not for screens: there are none to show yet.

highlights.title: Four layers of permission
highlights.text: Routing, the server, row-level security in the database and the paid plan each check access on their own, so one mistake does not open the door.

highlights.title: Roles per organisation
highlights.text: A person's role belongs to their membership of an organisation, not to their account, and students join by invitation only.

highlights.title: Decisions on record
highlights.text: Each architectural choice is written down with its reasons and the options that lost, before the code that depends on it.
